messages:
jordan_csm: Quick weekly health sync for Northstar Labs  hosted API commit vs run-rate check. Commit = $30,000/mo. 7-day extrapolated = $95,000/mo (~3.2x). Major delta from /v1/embeds-bulk. 7d tokens=2.1M, embeds +220% vs baseline, p95 latency=150ms, error rate steady 0.3% with a short spike to 1.5% at ~04:12 UTC yesterday. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/northstar/finops :mag:

fin-bot: :rotating_light: anomaly detected  account=Northstar route=/v1/embeds-bulk percent_increase=220% baseline_window=7d generated_ticket=CS-6120

rebecca_billing: saw the alert. we should avoid hard-cutting them. propose a $20k temporary buffer tied to this incident only. Jordan ok? :ledger:

omar_runtime: initial traces show one service (ingest-worker) accidentally switched to full-document embedding after a config flip. concurrent workers jumped from 6 -> 40. mitigation options: 1) per-key concurrency cap, 2) route large jobs to embed-lite, 3) short token-based soft throttle. recommend canary for routing change first.

jordan_csm: approve $20k buffer scoped to incident CS-6120. Rebecca please log with a note. Omar please canary routing change and let us know delta. Mark renewal risk = watch (usage volatility).

thomas_ops: scheduled a 25-min enablement called "Embedding best practices" for Northstar ops tomorrow 10am PT. will share a short SDK snippet during the call.

omar_runtime: canary pushed at 2751112400. rule used: curl -s -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/v1/controls/routing -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -d '{"account":"northstar","route":"/v1/embeds-bulk","fallback":"embed-lite","concurrency_cap":12,"token_threshold":80000}'

fin-bot: update: post-canary metrics at 2751112500  embeds surge reduced to +28%, p95 latency down to 110ms, error rate 0.2%. monitoring continues next_check=30m

rebecca_billing: buffer applied and note saved. I'll update renewal deck forecast and reduce near-term revenue expectation.

jordan_csm: nice mitigation. action items: OMAR drop post-canary before/after table; THOMAS run enablement call and add SDK snippet to docs; REBECCA confirm buffer in billing portal and update renewal slide. follow-up Friday 9am PT. thanks team. :raised_hands:
